title: Research: certify when precision refinement preserves inverse increments
body:
Increasing inverse precision can improve approximation while breaking exact dirty cancellation. A pinned PR628 leaf leaves residual 1/32 after a precision-four forward and precision-five inverse, while same-grid controls cancel. The package separately proves a rational grid-integrality criterion and checks 146,475 rational cases, 5,859 periods, 625 matrices and 264 actual leaf grid pairs. The retained same-grid caller remains valid.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/450b0f228807bbd88c6a37606070db54adf1dcfa/research/mixed-precision-inverse-boundary/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
